currentUserGoal: Fix immediate readability/UX issues found during user testing: Options overlap, low-resolution text, persistent TOUCH ROOTS label, and misleading Memory Grove affordability copy.
workCompleted: Moved the run HUD title to reserve space for the Options button and shortened the title from 'Ancient Grass: Scourge Prototype' to 'Ancient Grass: Scourge' so it no longer wraps into the objective lane.
Re-anchored the Memory Grove Options button to the Memory Grove frame when the meta screen is visible, while keeping it hidden on narrow compact meta layouts.
Added higher text resolution for persistent redesign Phaser text and transient float text.
Scoped CSS canvas image-rendering override to the redesign route so the redesign canvas is not forced through pixelated browser scaling.
Changed the large TOUCH ROOTS overlay so it only appears during the first wake objective, not throughout the full active run.
Changed locked Memory Grove node copy from ambiguous 'Need X GT' to 'Cost Y GT / Need X more'.
Documented the readability/affordability fixes in docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md.
verificationRun: npm run check passed after the fixes: ESLint, 30 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
git diff --check reported no whitespace errors, only expected Windows CRLF warnings.

A browser screenshot before the final touch-hint and text-readability patches confirmed the run title no longer collided with Options after shortening, but browser automation then began timing out on simple reload/click attempts.
Full post-fix visual browser verification is still needed because the in-app browser automation timed out repeatedly and reset its kernel.
knownIssues: Text readability should be improved by Text.setResolution(2) and redesign-only canvas image-rendering auto, but the user should visually confirm because browser automation timed out before a final screenshot could be captured.
The redesign route still uses many Phaser Text objects with mixed Georgia/Arial styles; a future font system pass may be needed for consistently crisp, charming UI text.
The Memory Grove affordability copy is clearer, but a future visual smoke should set up a state with owned Soft Touch and partial GT to verify the exact 'Need X more' node display in-browser.
The in-app browser automation timed out on simple route reload/click attempts late in the session. Reconnect fresh or use a new browser tab before the next visual smoke.
nextRecommendedSteps: Ask the user to reload http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign and check whether text readability and Options placement feel better.
If the text is still too soft or too crunchy, do a dedicated typography pass: choose a clearer UI font, reduce heavy strokes, and standardize font sizes/resolution.
Run a manual or fresh-browser smoke that reaches Memory Grove with partial GT and confirms locked nodes now read as total cost plus remaining shortfall.
After user approval, commit the accumulated redesign slice and handoff artifacts.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old permanent TOUCH ROOTS field label over ordinary gameplay.

Do not put Options back into title/subtitle lanes.
Keep the redesign route's DOM agent layer intact.
